'''LEP-171B''' was an [[LEP servant droid/Legends|LEP servant droid]] that assisted [[Tan Divo/Legends|Tan Divo]] during the investigation of [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr's]] [[Death/Legends|death]].

==Biography==
After the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]], LEP-171B accompanied [[Tan Divo/Legends|Tan Divo]] in the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor's]] [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|office]] as he revealed to the dead [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian's]] political allies, [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], and [[Lolo Purs/Legends|Lolo Purs]], that [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] Farr had in fact been [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]].

[[File:TanDivowithdroid.png|thumb|left|200px|The LEP droid assisted Tan Divo's investigations.]]
Later, Divo and the droid came to the docks after an apparent assassination attempt on the life of Amidala and Organa when they attempted to use their resources to look into Farr's murder. The [[Inspector/Legends|Inspector]] expressed his annoyance at Amidala's actions, as he believed that she had made his job much more difficult by alerting the killer to the investigation. Senator Amidala came to believe that her rival Senator [[Mee Deechi/Legends|Mee Deechi]] was responsible on the attempt on her life and ran back to the Senate with Divo and his droid in tow.

Upon arriving, the senators, Divo, and the droid found Deechi murdered. In order to secure the life of the other senators, Divo told them to stay within the Senate under heavy security, although Lolo Purs decided to depart. During the chain of events, Inspector Divo tried to locate Senator [[Halle Burtoni/Legends|Halle Burtoni]], but she was nowhere to be found. Later, Purs returned and claimed that Burtoni had attacked her, which later led to the [[Police droid/Legends|police droid's]] arrest of Burtoni. Initial questioning led Burtoni to deny any involvement in both Farr's murder and the attack on Purs. However, Lieutenant Divo's investigation revealed that a [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]]-made poison had been used to kill Senator Farr. Although Divo prepared to take Burtoni into custody, Purs was revealed to be the culprit, and the Rodian was instead arrested.
